_about: WIELDER MCP client configuration (wielder/mcp_client.py). Each server is spawned over stdio by the official mcp python-sdk when the manager discovers or calls it; its tools register as mcp__<name>__<tool> in the schema-validated tool layer. A server entry is owner configuration — the same trust class as a registered method's implementing script. Example: {"name": "example", "command": "python3", "args": ["-m", "some_mcp_server"], "env": {}}. Empty by default.
